title: Blood Censor Pack (Yellow)
description: A pack that censors blood simulated via redstone particles making it yellow
body:
# Tired of seeing blood when punching mobs?
This resourcepack changes that by recolouring the redstone block texture often used to simulate blood on servers
![Yellow Block particles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7563f8f62e2a1dff0523164b53bcd78e3e116d55.png)
